title: Cumberland Curling Club
specs: Volunteer-run club with social traditions and sportsmanship emphasis
All guests stepping onto the ice must bring a pair of clean indoor shoes carried in a gear bag
Youth guests require a parent or guardian on site to sign
Wearing a CSA-approved helmet is highly recommended but not mandatory for adults
includes: Full access to two sheets of curling ice
Use of club equipment including brooms, sliders, and grippers
Access to viewing lounge and service by volunteer bartenders
Basic instruction from a volunteer for new or inexperienced curlers
gap: Physical address of the club not stated
blurb: Guests can rent curling ice and equipment for events such as birthday parties, family gatherings, or corporate team-building. Rentals include access to two sheets of curling ice, club equipment, and the viewing lounge with volunteer bartenders. Basic instruction is provided for new or inexperienced curlers.
extraNote: 100% league refunds minus $25 admin fee if requested before registration deadline · Requests made after deadline but before opening day are subject to non-refundable association fees
